subject: Follow-up: NimbusAI marketplace procurement & commercial path
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimbusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks — quick follow-up & procurement questions (marketplace path)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the great call earlier — appreciate you walking through the evaluation goals and latency/cost targets. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the open procurement/commercial items so we can align next steps.

Quick summary of asks from my side:
- Procurement vehicle: Do you expect to purchase via card (self-serve) or through a PO/net-terms? If PO, is net30 the standard?
- Marketplace interest: Are you planning to buy via AWS Marketplace (SaaS Contracts), GCP Marketplace, or direct contract? You mentioned AWS briefly — can you confirm?
- Vendor setup: Do you have an internal vendor form / legal questionnaire we should complete? If so, please send the latest version and the billing/procurement contact.
- Timeline: What is your target procurement completion date (internal approval + PO issuance)?

Next steps we propose:
1) If marketplace is preferred (AWS/GCP), we can provide the marketplace listing spec and sample billing flow to share with procurement.
2) If PO/net-terms, I’ll loop in our finance lead to confirm commercial terms and expedite the vendor setup.
3) We’ll put together a one-page mutual action plan (timeline/milestones) once you confirm your preferred path.

Can you confirm the answers above and attach any vendor paperwork? I’ll follow up with pricing and marketplace docs once I have your procurement preference.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimbusai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick follow-up & procurement questions (marketplace path)

Hi Camila — thanks for the recap.

Answers below:
- Procurement vehicle: We prefer to purchase via PO with net30. Card is occasionally used for POCs but not for production budget.
- Marketplace interest: Yes, we would prefer AWS Marketplace SaaS Contracts if you can support that path. GCP is a secondary option.
- Vendor setup: Attached is our vendor form and our procurement contact is Samantha Ortiz (samantha.ortiz@nimbusai.com). Samantha handles vendor onboarding and will route to legal.
- Timeline: Targeting procurement completion by end of November (11/30). We need vendor paperwork and pricing to move this internally.

Attaching: Nimbus_Vendor_Form.pdf (vendor form)

Jordan
Jordan Lee
VP Product, NimbusAI
jordan.lee@nimbusai.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimbusai.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus vendor form + procurement path — action items

Team — forwarding Jordan's reply and vendor form. Key asks:
- Jordan prefers AWS Marketplace SaaS Contracts and will purchase via PO (net30). Target procurement complete by 11/30.
- Attached vendor form (Nimbus_Vendor_Form.pdf) — legal/procurement will review.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you draft a marketplace-friendly commercial summary (price per instance / seat / token-based) and note any marketplace delta vs direct procurement? We should include typical implementation timeline and SLAs.
- Jonas: please prepare the AWS Marketplace intake/requirements doc (billing flow, usage metering expectations) and a short checklist for Marketplace listing readiness.

I'll coordinate with Samantha once the draft docs are ready. Goal: have materials to send to procurement by next week.

Thanks — Camila

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimbusai.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick follow-up & procurement questions (marketplace path)

Hi Jordan — appreciate the quick responses and the vendor form.

Confirming next steps from our side:
- We will prepare a marketplace-ready one-page commercial summary and the AWS Marketplace intake doc (Jonas will own the technical billing notes).
- Marissa will produce a draft pricing sheet and note any differences between Marketplace and direct billing.
- I’ll send back the completed vendor form where applicable and a DocuSign link for PO if we need to route a direct SAAS contract (fallback if marketplace intake timing doesn't align with your timeline).

Can Samantha (cc'd here) confirm whether AWS Marketplace SaaS Contracts are acceptable for NimbusAI or if they require vendor onboarding only via direct PO? Also, please confirm the procurement email we should expect the PO from.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://na1.docusign.net/placeholder-doc/NW-3487
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company.tld/deal/NW-3487
AWS Marketplace intake: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/partners/nimbusai-intake

Best,
Camila
